response.overview: This is story about a poor painter who sale's his picture, and handling his younger sister and younger brother. A girl who belong from a rich family she falling in love with the painter. That girl's father does not like all this and he killed both. There is another story in this movie but something different. Meera and Vishwas, they handle the "Fashion House" for youngsters who wants to a become a model. They invited new youth to become models in "Fashion House" through social media. And here begins the new twist of the story ....During fashion, fun, romance, and shooting but in all this situation all youngsters killed by someone. And starting horrible orgy of death. Who is doing this? Soul? Ghost ? Phantom? Devil? Magic ? Or else ? What is the connection between the first story and the second story? You will have to see such horrible, horror, suspense, thrill, romantic love story, then you will got answers to all these questions.
response.title: Fashion House
